directClientError.message: Target is not a safe public address

interpretation: The registered read-only connector and fail-closed network policy ran. The current environment resolved api.github.com to a non-public address, so no external request was sent and no repository data was fabricated.
recovery: Provide an approved public DNS/network egress for the Jinyiwei host, then rerun this exact probe. Do not weaken the public-address check or substitute fixture data for a real-source claim.
